posts.title: A difficulty in race-switching the Dukes of Hazzard
posts.description: A couple of weeks ago I considered a version of The Dukes of Hazzard in which most of the characters, and the Duke Brothers themselves, were Black. I overlooked at least one important detail that I have not been able to resolve. posts.title: On futile explanations
posts.description: The best sentence I wrote last week: It's true that ‘California regulatory compliance / bureaucratic dysfunction’ is a plausible explanation, but without specific details it's unsatisfying in the same way as ‘it's God's will’: it applies equally well to all puzzles and it explains nothing.
